report.summary: All 26 tests are errors at session setup, not assertion failures: the `base_url` fixture starts the app with uvicorn and it exits with code 1 before answering /health, so no test body runs. The application code gives no sign of a fault, so this is an environment/startup problem; the first step is to run `python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000` from the repo root in the same venv and read the traceback, since the child process's stderr is not in this report.

causes.title: Test-session app process exits with code 1 during startup
causes.explanation: Every test depends on the session-scoped `base_url` fixture, which launches `uvicorn app.main:app` as a subprocess and polls it for readiness. The process died with return code 1 before becoming healthy, so `_wait_until_up` raised RuntimeError and all 26 tests errored in setup. The run shows the failure happening on a developer Windows machine (paths under C:/Users/IvanPosavec, venv under qa-lab), not a clean CI runner. Nothing in app/main.py looks broken on import: the module-level schema creation (app/main.py:57-58) and the DB_PATH handling (app/main.py:20, 48) are ordinary. The likely causes are environmental: uvicorn or a dependency missing from the venv, a bad APP_DB_PATH or DB_PATH value pointing to a directory that does not exist or is not writable, or a port/file lock problem. The captured failure does not include the child's stderr, so the exact exception is unknown.
evidence: tests\conftest.py:35: raise RuntimeError(f"App exited early with code {proc.returncode}") -> "RuntimeError: App exited early with code 1"
tests\conftest.py:58-62: subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-m", "uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--port", str(port), "--log-level", "warning"], cwd=ROOT, env=env) with stderr not captured
tests\conftest.py:56-57: db_path = os.environ.get("APP_DB_PATH") or str(tmp_path_factory.mktemp("db") / "bookshelf.db"); env = {**os.environ, "DB_PATH": db_path}
app/main.py:57-58: with db() as _conn: _conn.executescript(SCHEMA) runs at import time, so any DB open failure stops the app before it serves requests
list_failures: all 26 entries (api and ui, including the [chromium] UI tests) fail with the same setup error, so the cause is shared and not per test
causes.suggested_fix: Reproduce by running `python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000` from the repo root with the project venv and DB_PATH set to a temp file. Read the traceback. Confirm uvicorn and the requirements are installed in that venv (`pip install -r requirements-dev.txt`), and check that APP_DB_PATH, if set, points to a writable location. Then rerun the suite. Also make conftest.py capture or print the child's stderr (e.g. stderr=subprocess.PIPE, or log it when the process exits early) so the next failure is self-explanatory.
